subject.name: Prepress Technicians and Workers
subject.summary: Prepress technicians turn the text, images, fonts, and layout of a design file into a printable file, performing file preflight, proofing, and quality control, with some positions making printing plates. O*NET 51-5111.00 lists proofing, proofreading, layout, font and image file checking, and plate making as tasks. File release follows customer confirmation, equipment specifications, and in-plant procedures, and a screen preview cannot replace the printed result.
